fixture.detail: Private token file setup; NewServer receives the real SessionStore. Token-file I/O is incidental to auth predicates.

post.detail: Direct httptest recorder to ServeHTTP; no HTTP socket exchange.

store-fixture.detail: Starts upstream natsserver.NewServer at loopback ephemeral TCP with JetStream disk directory; nats.Connect(srv.ClientURL()), jetstream.New, OpenSessionStore. This is not natscell.Start and not an in-process protocol client.

valid-helper.detail: Delegates to manager.valid and fails on error.

read-hook.detail: Fault wrapper delegates exactly to the supplied closure; root-specific closures either synthesize errors or delegate to original leader.GetLastMsg.

watch-hook.detail: Counts/inspects deadline; down and blocking paths synthesize errors/cancellation; healthy path delegates to real KeyValue.Watch.

slow-create.detail: Delay/counter wrapper delegates successful operations to actual KeyValue.Create.

update-fault.detail: Always synthesizes DeadlineExceeded without a KV update; preservation is separately read from real store.

create-hook.detail: Runs before hook then actual KeyValue.Create; runs after hook only on success; lostAck replaces successful response with timeout after commit.

open.detail: Creates file-backed JetStream KV, obtains actual leader context and stream.

get.detail: Calls leader.GetLastMsg with bounded caller context and rejects KV operation markers.

register.detail: Reads actual token record, Create/Update CAS before publishing binding and collection; failure returns before collect.

retry.detail: Listener-owned retry loop calls real latest/collect and rollback operations after bounded backoff.

rollback.detail: Uses bounded context independent of canceled request and retains failed rollback.

allocation-purge.detail: Unknown revision reads actual committed hash before purge; revision cutoff preserves reuse.

current.detail: Delegates to latest then compares token hash/generation.

reconcile.detail: Reads latest binding and preserves token fence.

collect.detail: Real KV Watch; purges only old generations or operation markers through sequence bound.

purge.detail: Actual stream.Purge with subject and revision+1 cutoff.

occupied.detail: Real KV Watch snapshot for occupied slots.

issue.detail: Reconciles actual token, CAS creates session record, final generation read and rollback; nil binding guard and local host map are distinct branches.

slot.detail: Pure string/number/base64 validation; malformed values return before store.

valid.detail: Shape guard, actual session leader read and final token fence; only miss reconciles. Nil binding fails locally.

revoke.detail: Shape/nil binding guards; otherwise actual latest/session read, conditional KV Purge, marker read and stream compaction.

authenticated.detail: No cookie returns locally; present cookie delegates valid.

login-mount.detail: Mounts local handlers; logout guard precedes revoke, then clears cookie and redirects.

login.detail: Local form/origin/token/redirect guards; successful login valid/issue crosses real store before SetCookie/redirect.

constructor.detail: Validates/reads private token file then newServer; no listener bind.

new-server.detail: Attaches real store via SetSessionStore only if Sessions supplied; otherwise local mux construction.

serve.detail: Direct mux path with header guards, no listener needed.

auth.detail: Bearer/no-cookie local paths; only mounted cookie authentication reaches session store.

start.detail: Binds actual TCP listener and starts session retry goroutine; test postLogin still uses direct recorder.

close.detail: Cancels/joins session cleanup then closes HTTP server.

token-read.detail: Real private-file read at construction; incidental setup for local auth predicate roots.

qualification_limits: Runtime UNKNOWN_NO_RECEIPTS_REVIEWED_NO_EXECUTION; no builds/tests/helper/runtime execution or receipts reviewed.
Source categories exhaust only literal2380:2400 allocation; no ledger/count promotion, retirement, deletion or global completion credit.
Upstream loopback NATS fixture, single replica/file-backed JetStream; not natscell.Start, in-process protocol clients, live cloud or multi-node HA.
httptest recorders are direct handler calls; HTTP socket exchange is not claimed. Listener lifecycle source covers retry ownership, not external HTTP traffic.
Synthetic GetLastMsg/Update/Watch errors are distinguished from delegated real operations. Setup token files and real records do not qualify an independent predicate/guard.
No durability across machine failure, power loss, distributed partitions, production Vault/browser behavior or race-detector result inferred.
No source-visible contradictory blocker identified in the allocated assertion paths; any future correction must preserve these original obligations.
All assertions, malformed cases, trust boundaries, fencing, bounded cancellation, retry, revision-reuse and byte-preservation obligations retained.
